subject: Post-call: Dedicated vs Private VPC - data isolation follow-up
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@finsecure.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Dedicated vs Private VPC - data isolation follow-up

Hi Alice / team,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great discussion. Quick recap and next steps from our side so we stay aligned on requirements and timing: 

Summary of your stated requirements (please correct any misinterpretations):
- Strict network isolation: customer-owned VPC or single-tenant network; no shared tenancy for inference endpoints.
- Customer-managed KMS for at-rest encryption (need to bring your own key).
- Audit logs & full access to request/response audit trail for compliance.
- Controls to ensure model weights and model updates do not leave customer boundary (preference for Private VPC or on-prem if required).

How Redwood modes map to those needs (high-level):
- Hosted API: multi-tenant, quick to spin up, not suitable if you require VPC-only network isolation or customer-managed KMS.
- Dedicated capacity: single-tenant GPU pools operated by Redwood; offers tenant isolation at compute level but still uses Redwood-managed networking unless we pair it with a Private VPC offering.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): hosted inside your VPC or on-prem with customer-managed networking and KMS; aligns best with strict isolation and regulatory requirements.

Proposed next steps:
1) Can you confirm whether customer-managed KMS + VPC peering is a hard requirement vs a strong preference?
2) Would you be open to a technical deep-dive (1 hour) with our infra/security engineer to walk through Private VPC architecture (KMS integration, audit logs, model lifecycle controls)?
3) If Private is needed, can you share the rough procurement timeline and any SOC2 / security package items we should prepare?

I attached a short overview of Redwood Private (Redwood_Private_VPC_overview.pdf) and our SOC2 summary. Happy to jump on a call next week — proposed slots: Tue 6/22 10-11am PT or Wed 6/23 1-2pm PT.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: Redwood_Private_VPC_overview.pdf, SOC2_summary.pdf

From: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@finsecure.com>

Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Dedicated vs Private VPC - data isolation follow-up

Hi Mateo / Marissa,

Thanks for the clear summary. Confirming the security posture we need: 
- VPC-only access is required; endpoints must be in our account (no public internet routing).
- Customer-managed KMS is required for all persisted artifacts and logs.
- Audit logs with retention of at least 12 months and ability to export for audits.
- We need assurance that model weights and any training data do not leave our VPC or are under our control.

Short answers to your questions: 
1) KMS + VPC peering is a hard requirement for our security/compliance team.
2) Yes to a technical deep-dive. Please include your infra/security engineer and any diagrams you have for Private VPC + KMS integration.
3) Procurement timeline: target contract signing by end of Q3 2026. We'll be sharing a completed security questionnaire and have attached our initial worksheet (FinSecure_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx). Procurement will need a draft SOW and high-level pricing to start legal review.

Looping in Bob Lee (cc) from our infra team; he can coordinate the technical call.

Thanks,
Alice Johnson
Security Lead | FinSecure
alice.johnson@finsecure.com

Alice / Bob — thanks for confirming. A few clarifications and what we'll prepare for the deep-dive: 

Clarifications:
- Private VPC: we can deploy a customer-dedicated control plane that runs in your VPC (or a Private Hosted option where compute is dedicated and peered into your network). That supports customer-managed KMS and keeps all persistent state in your account.
- Dedicated capacity: provides single-tenant GPU pools but does not, by itself, provide VPC-resident endpoints unless paired with our Private deployment option.
- Audit logs: we can stream audit logs to your Cloud Logging (S3/GCS/Syslog) and configure retention policies to meet the 12-month requirement.

What I will bring to the deep-dive:
- Diagram of Private VPC architecture and KMS integration
- Example config snippets for log export and KV cache isolation
- Reference SOC2 package and a draft SOW outline for procurement

I attached the Private VPC overview (Redwood_Private_VPC_overview.pdf) and our draft SOW template to give procurement a starting point. Proposed deep-dive slots: Tue 6/22 10:00am PT (works for us) — I'll hold that time unless you prefer a different slot.

Next steps for FinSecure: please fill out any gaps in the questionnaire you attached and let us know which people from infra/security should join.

Best,
